summary: Objects may be a road NP (114/18; PrS 45/28), persons indexed by suffixes (MAC Hanna Dewo/106; PrS 43/103), or an understood scene (113/198). These ordinary argument variants remain within II.1.

m- marks vantage from a castle (PrS 43/103) or an optical viewing channel (114/22); the latter has no overt observed object. A bow is b-marked in the aiming use (96/347), already included in the inherited gloss.
No source supports conflating this watching homonym with ʕyš 1 living. Contracted kəmʕašlan is retained verbatim rather than normalized to mʕayš-.
No specialized idiom is added: watching a road, looking through a telescope and aiming with a bow have transparent meanings covered by the existing gloss.
